game.name: ASHVALE
game.description: New in 0.8.104: Solitaire at the card tables - long-press a table and play. Cards with their rank and suit in both corners, a turn clock round the felt, and GOLD on a table always comes home. ASHVALE is free to play: knights, wizards and archers, the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, the Chess Park, and the Ojibwe village of Ziibiing on the far continent.
